**4.2.0 notes are written.** No breaking changes. One real feature and nine user-visible fixes, buried in 380 commits of deps and refactors.

Watch `fix(auth)`: expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. That's a behavior change for anyone branching on status codes, flagged in the notes.

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Next: check the auth status-code note with whoever owns client SDKs.
